[[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms']] '''Flame Rifle'''<ref name="ROE" /> was a hand-held weapon that operated on the same principle as a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flame projector]]. The bell-mouthed weapon ejected a spontaneously ignited liquid that adhered to the intended object, destroying anything it touched.<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> The Flame Rifle was used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Heavy Weapons Specialists]] and [[Urban Guerrillas/Legends|Urban Guerrillas]].<ref name="ROE" />
